title: TRM Swarm OS — Sovereign Capability Task Suite
description: 20 high-value tasks exercising the full capability stack: 217-state toroidal ternary, fractal computation, 6-tier hybrid intelligence, real-world autonomous deployment, and multi-language regulatory compliance.

tasks.expected_output: 11.4M+ architectures at Depth 5 verified; Depth 6 reaches 170.9M with 99.98% coherence.

tasks.title: Mamba-3 SSM State Evolution on 4D Torus
tasks.objective: Map TRM 7M Mamba-3 state-space model hidden states onto the Clifford torus, using the spiral recurrence turn τ as the SSM time index and facet f as the state amplitude.
tasks.expected_output: O(1) memory SSM with zero state drift across 10,000 recurrent steps on torus.

tasks.expected_output: 0.00 ppm detuning with Φ_V = 0.9115 harmonic index maintained across 100 nodes.

tasks.title: Continuous Toroidal Embedding of 153.5M Trit Knowledge Fabric
tasks.objective: Embed the entire 153.5M trit sovereign knowledge base as a point cloud on the 4D Clifford torus, enabling geodesic similarity search in constant O(1) time via facet indexing.
tasks.expected_output: 9.85 ns retrieval with 100% hit rate; semantic neighbors within ±3 facets of query point.

tasks.title: Cross-Tier Molecular Design Pipeline: TRM 7M → Bonsai 27B → Instella MoE
tasks.objective: Route a single drug discovery query through all 6 intelligence tiers: TRM 7M detects target site geometry, Bonsai 27B generates 50 novel scaffolds, Instella MoE formally verifies binding thermodynamics, Qwen-Coder synthesizes docking code, Gemma3 translates results to 5 languages, TRM 7M executes on bare metal.
tasks.expected_output: Full pipeline completes in < 200 µs with 10 novel leads, 5 verified proofs, and 5-language documentation.

tasks.title: Real-Time PBFT Consensus with Toroidal Weighting
tasks.objective: Execute 14-agent PBFT consensus where each agent's vote weight is its toroidal facet amplitude. Agents closer to +108 (generative) receive higher weight for creative proposals; agents near −108 (pruning) receive higher weight for risk assessment.
tasks.expected_output: Unanimous +1 Gold with weighted score +0.985 in < 16 µs.

tasks.title: Autonomous SEU Healing with Facet-Aware Memory Antibodies
tasks.objective: Deploy 2,050 DDR memory antibodies that classify bit-flip severity by toroidal facet distance from State 0. Facets ±1 to ±10 receive immediate hardware healing; ±11 to ±50 trigger PBFT revalidation; ±51+ trigger Phoenix state rollback.
tasks.expected_output: 10,000/10,000 SEU faults healed with zero residual corruption; mean healing latency 2.1 ns.

tasks.title: Federated Clinical Trial with 217-State Differential Privacy
tasks.objective: Process 148,200 FHIR events across 12 hospital nodes using the toroidal quantizer to discretize patient data into 217 privacy-preserving facets before federated aggregation. Each facet ±k maps to a differential privacy noise level ε_k = ε_base / (|k| + 1).
tasks.expected_output: Zero raw data leakage; Day-7 clearance 91.3%; FDA eCTD Module 5 auto-generated.

tasks.title: GPU-Accelerated Docking with Toroidal Grid Interpolation
tasks.objective: Modify the CUDA/HIP docking energy kernel to use 217-state toroidal facets instead of floating-point grid values. Each grid cell stores a facet index −108 to +108; trilinear interpolation becomes majority-vote facet selection with K3 min/max algebra.
tasks.expected_output: 500,000 compound screen in 84.5 min at 10.75× GPU speedup with zero precision loss vs float32.

tasks.title: Kisumu AMR Sentinel with 217-State Resistance Classification
tasks.objective: Deploy the Raspberry Pi 4 Kisumu node with upgraded firmware that classifies each MIC resistance reading into one of 217 toroidal facets, where facet magnitude encodes resistance severity and facet sign encodes resistance mechanism (negative = enzymatic, positive = efflux).
tasks.expected_output: 1,420 samples processed at 4.12 ms each; 48 resistant isolates classified with 100% accuracy; outbreak alert in 3.8 ms.

tasks.title: 5-Node Chagas Consortium with Toroidal Lead Scoring
tasks.objective: Re-run the 500,000 compound Chagas screen using the 217-state torus as the lead-scoring function. Compounds whose docking energy facet > +72 are prioritized for synthesis; facets < −36 are pruned automatically.
tasks.expected_output: 3 sub-nanomolar leads (Cruzain Kd=1.84nM, TcGAPDH Kd=3.12nM, CYP51 Kd=0.95nM); 20 synthesis protocols.

tasks.expected_output: 142 AEs mapped to MedDRA PT codes in < 1 ms each; 0 SAEs; 91.3% Day-7 clearance.

tasks.title: 100-Node Federation Boot with Toroidal Node Addressing
tasks.objective: Assign each of the 100 federation nodes a toroidal address (facet, turn) where facet = node role (generative/neutral/pruning) and turn = node position in the spiral recurrence. Enables O(1) routing via torus geodesic distance.
tasks.expected_output: 100 nodes addressable in O(1); 12.8 µs sync latency; 99.975% cross-stage coherence.

tasks.title: Zero-Cloud Sovereign Portal with 217-State Visualization
tasks.objective: Build an offline-capable sovereign web portal that renders the 4D Clifford torus in real-time using WebGL, displaying live agent telemetry as colored points on the toroidal manifold with facet magnitude as radial distance and turn as angular position.
tasks.expected_output: Interactive torus visualization with 14 agent avatars, live telemetry at 3-second intervals, zero cloud dependency.

tasks.title: 10-Language Regulatory Dossier Generation with Facet-Encoded Safety Data
tasks.objective: Generate complete regulatory dossiers for TRM-ABX-220 in 10 languages (EN, ES, FR, DE, PT, IT, JA, KO, ZH, AR) where all safety data points are encoded as toroidal facets with automatic translation of facet severity bands.
tasks.expected_output: 10 complete dossiers with Grade 5.8 readability; zero translation drift; regulatory compliance verified.

tasks.title: FAERS Global Pharmacovigilance with Multi-Language Facet Triage
tasks.objective: Process FAERS adverse event reports in 5 languages (French, Spanish, German, Japanese, Arabic) using the 217-state torus to triage severity: facets ±1-20 = routine monitoring, ±21-50 = expedited review, ±51-108 = emergency DSMB alert.
tasks.expected_output: All reports mapped to MedDRA PT codes with severity facet; Naranjo causality scores computed automatically.

tasks.title: CNIPA Chinese Patent Translation with 217-State Chemical Space Mapping
tasks.objective: Translate Chinese CNIPA patent documents describing LpxC inhibitors while mapping each chemical structure to its toroidal facet position in chemical space, enabling cross-lingual patent infringement detection.
tasks.expected_output: Patent claims translated with IC50 < 5.0 nM accurately extracted; chemical space overlap detected.

tasks.title: Iberian-American Clinical Trial Protocol Harmonization

tasks.expected_output: Protocols harmonized across 12 Latin American sites with zero dosing ambiguity.

tasks.title: Real-Time Multilingual Patient Monitoring with Facet-Encoded Alerts
tasks.objective: Deploy bedside patient monitoring that generates alerts in the patient's native language (10 languages) with severity encoded as toroidal facet: higher |facet| = more urgent alert with louder/brighter notification.
